factors.name: contractedDemand
factors.basis: Nebius disclosed a five-year Meta agreement for $12B of dedicated capacity plus up to $15B of additional available compute capacity, with delivery beginning in early 2027.

factors.name: financingCapacity
factors.basis: Nebius closed approximately $4.3375B of convertible senior notes in March 2026 for data-center buildout, AI-cloud investment, footprint expansion and key components including GPUs.

risks: Contract value is not equivalent to recognized revenue, margin or free cash flow; delivery begins in the future and requires capacity execution.
Convertible financing adds repayment and potential dilution exposure.
unknowns: Deployment-level margins and utilization for the Meta capacity are not disclosed in the cited announcement.
The cited financing announcements do not establish realized returns on the funded capacity.

factors.name: capitalExecution
factors.basis: Nebius disclosed a $775M senior secured facility backed by deployed GPU infrastructure and contracted cash flows; together with customer cash flows it states the facility covers more than 100% of capex for the underlying deployment.

factors.name: contractedCapacityExecution
factors.basis: In the July 17 financing announcement Nebius said it had delivered the latest planned Microsoft capacity tranche and remained on track for remaining contracted tranches.

risks: The secured facility encumbers GPU infrastructure and contracted cash flows and increases fixed obligations.
Execution remains exposed to GPU supply, power, construction, commissioning and customer concentration.
unknowns: No independent source in this assist verifies deployment economics or customer-level profitability.
Alpha still owns numeric underwriting, valuation and data-confidence judgments.

observedFacts: Up to $15B additional available compute capacity commitment over five years.
Dedicated capacity delivery scheduled to begin in early 2027.
Approximately $775M senior secured facility backed by deployed GPU infrastructure and contracted cash flows.
Facility matures October 31, 2030 and is priced at SOFR + 2.50%.
Nebius states facility plus customer cash flows cover more than 100% of capex for the underlying deployment.
Issuer states latest planned Microsoft capacity tranche was delivered and remaining tranches were on schedule.
Closed $2.5875B 2031 notes and $1.75B 2033 notes, approximately $4.3375B aggregate principal at closing.
Proceeds intended for data-center construction/buildout, AI-cloud investment, footprint expansion, GPUs and general corporate purposes.

recommendation: Alpha should map these source-addressed facts only to Methodology 1.0 factors it can lawfully score, preserve issuer-origin confidence limits, and obtain any missing valuation/financial statement inputs before creating the numeric underwriting record.
